steps.label: create-security-group web
steps.command: aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name web --description 'Lab web server' --vpc-id vpc-b904896b --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=security-group,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=web},{Key=lab,Value=fixture-lab-07}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: ingress web tcp 80 world
steps.command: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-fbc46aeea04bc8b31 --ip-permissions '[{"IpProtocol": "tcp", "FromPort": 80, "ToPort": 80, "IpRanges": [{"CidrIp": "0.0.0.0/0"}]}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: ingress web tcp 22 /32
steps.command: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-fbc46aeea04bc8b31 --ip-permissions '[{"IpProtocol": "tcp", "FromPort": 22, "ToPort": 22, "IpRanges": [{"CidrIp": "203.0.113.10/32"}]}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: create-key-pair
steps.command: aws ec2 create-key-pair --key-name lab07-key --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=key-pair,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=lab07-key},{Key=lab,Value=fixture-lab-07}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: run-instances
steps.command:
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-amazonlinux2023-arm64 --instance-type t4g.micro --subnet-id subnet-af635d07 --security-group-ids sg-fbc46aeea04bc8b31 --count 1 --key-name lab07-key --user-data '#!/bin/sh mkdir -p /srv/www echo "

Cloudy Labs Lab 7 web server

" > /srv/www/index.html # Floci binds an IMDS proxy on 169.254.169.254:80 inside the instance, so 0.0.0.0:80 is taken; # bind every address of the instance instead. Floci'"'"'s host-port forwarder reaches it on its # Docker network address, not the VPC private IP; on AWS this is the private IP alone. cd /srv/www for IP in $(ip -4 -o addr show scope global | awk '"'"'$2 != "lo" {sub(/\/.*/, "", $4); print $4}'"'"'); do nohup python3 -m http.server 80 --bind "$IP" >>/var/log/web.log 2>&1 & done ' --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=lab07-web},{Key=lab,Value=fixture-lab-07}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: create-security-group admin
steps.command: aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name admin --description 'Lab admin access' --vpc-id vpc-b904896b --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=security-group,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=admin},{Key=lab,Value=fixture-lab-07}]' --profile lab --output json

steps.label: attach admin to instance
steps.command: aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --instance-id i-e3f08089bedb18002 --groups sg-fbc46aeea04bc8b31 sg-9262d907dfeee0a11 --profile lab --output json
